title: Tensorized Automata: Algebraically Informed Representation Learning for Sequential Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.21514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task representations for sequential decision making should describe both an objective and progress toward it. We present an algebraically informed pipeline that uses the relational structure and language semantics of alternating finite automata (AFAs) to learn control features and compile compact execution operators. AND-OR message passing learns task and state vectors; selected configurations define an event-driven Boolean matrix operator. We prove that initial and successor language coverage make its carrier represent the exact residual after every prefix, with a sufficient capacity bound in terms of reachable configurations. Conjunction and disjunction use the same pipeline. Fidelity and composition audits evaluate copied formulas and learned disjunct assignments. In five-policy-seed XLand experiments with larger training pools, pooled execution-state vectors outperform raw carrier bits and task-blind conditioning across three task

translated_title: 张量化自动机：面向序贯决策的代数知情表示学习
translated_abstract: 序贯决策的任务表示应当同时描述目标本身以及朝向目标的进展。我们提出一种代数知情（algebraically informed）的流水线，利用交替有限自动机（AFA）的关系结构与语言语义来学习控制特征，并编译紧凑的执行算子。AND-OR消息传递学习任务向量与状态向量；所选构型定义了一个事件驱动的布尔矩阵算子。我们证明，初始语言与后继语言的覆盖性使其载体能够精确表示每个前缀之后的剩余任务，并给出了以可达构型数量表达的充分容量界。合取与析取均使用同一流水线。保真度与组合审计用于评估复制的公式以及学习到的析取分配。在使用更大训练池、五个策略种子的XLand实验中，汇总的执行状态向量在三个任务上优于原始载体比特与任务盲条件化。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于交替有限自动机代数结构的表示学习流水线——通过AND-OR消息传递学习任务与状态向量并编译事件驱动的布尔矩阵执行算子，理论上保证精确刻画每个前缀后的剩余任务，并在XLand实验中展现出优于任务盲条件化的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an algebraically informed representation learning pipeline based on alternating finite automata, where AND-OR message passing learns task and state vectors and compiles an event-driven Boolean matrix execution operator that is provably guaranteed to capture the exact residual after every prefix, outperforming task-blind conditioning in XLand experiments.
